title: Hello Kitty Ambient Table Lamp RGB LED Lamp Light Dual Color Function Brand New
categoryName: Collectibles:Animation Art & Merchandise:Animation Merchandise:Other Animation Merchandise
descriptionText:
This ambient table lamp is the perfect addition to any Hello Kitty collection. With its RGB LED light and dual color function, it sets the mood in any room. The lamp is made of durable plastic and features the iconic Hello Kitty character in multicolor. 

The lamp was manufactured in 2002 in China and is part of the Hello Kitty Sanrio TV show franchise. It is a great collectible for any animation merchandise collector or fan of the Hello Kitty brand. Add this lamp to your collection today and bring a piece of Hello Kitty into your home.
